targetText: But an existence worthy of human beings cannot be the manner of living of a single privileged nation, for, being isolated from all other nations, it could neither establish nor maintain this condition.
summary: Bebel shows that socialist emancipation is inherently international: global trade, scientific cooperation, universal federated peace, and world infrastructure projects will replace nationalist chauvinism, colonial wars, and military borders.
